archimate:DataObject.name: Enterprise Business Payload (Body)
archimate:DataObject.documentation:
While items 1 and 2 define the mandatory standardized header envelope, item 3 governs the logical structure and attributes for the Business Payload Body:
Domain Attributes & Entity State: Contains entity-specific business data attributes formatted in standard camelCase (e.g., schemeId, fundingAllocation, status, partnerId).
ISO 4217 Currency Standards: All financial and monetary values must be represented as numeric decimals (minimum two decimal places, e.g., 1500000.00) and accompanied by a separate ISO 4217 three-letter currency code attribute (e.g., currencyCode: "GBP")
Spatial Entity Anchoring: Any business entity referring to physical land or property must include a siteSpatialAnchor (referencing the Esri UPRN or Global ID) within its core body attributes to ensure spatial identity resolution across domain applications.
